G4_actual_production_audit.scope: Every completed production job, not only the two live gate probes

G5.scope: full saved 200000-pair native DPPO update at default flags; 20 actor and critic optimizer steps, parameters, both optimizer/scheduler states, global RNG, logged values and fixed-noise sampling

G3.limitation: Only update 0 has exact historical running-scaler state; later fitted divisors are frozen approximations.

G4.environment_seeding: Production seeded_batch requires acknowledgments that private MuJoCo/reset and action-space RNGs were seeded before every batch.
